newsitem.title: USA: New Zealand tourist dies in fall from NY hotel.
newsitem.headline: New Zealand tourist dies in fall from NY hotel.

text.p: A 27-year-old New Zealand tourist died when he fell out of a 12th floor window of an East Side Manhattan hotel, police said on Sunday.

Police said the victim, Byran Buckminster Donovan of Christchurch on New Zealand's South Island fell when he leaned too far out the window of his room at the Gershwin Hotel where he had been staying for the last two months.
"He landed on the ground in the alley of the hotel," a police spokeswoman said. He was pronounced dead at the scene. The hotel is at the corner of Fifth Avenue and E. 27th Street.
Donovan died at 8 a.m. EDT (1200 GMT), Saturday but police did not release details until his family was notified.
